properties.lc_display_text: At 0.00 seconds, a dimly lit bar back room filled with cigarette smoke is shown. Three people are seated around a wooden table playing cards. The person on the left, a young woman with long blonde hair and wearing an olive green parka with a fur-lined hood, holds a glass of margarita in her hand; she has closed eyes and a calm expression. In the center, a man dressed in a black tuxedo with a silver tie is seated, holding cards in his hands, preparing to deal. The person on the right, a woman wearing a dark blue leather jacket and sporting short brown hair, leans forward slightly, watching intently as she holds her hand near the table. A stack of playing cards lies face down between them. At 0.98 seconds, the man in the center begins dealing a card to the woman on the right with his right hand; the card slides across the table toward her and lands flat. She doesn’t react immediately but watches closely as she holds up her left hand to receive it at 1.25 seconds. Her eyes snap open briefly, then close again in concentration. At 1.70 seconds, a low hum of cigarette smoke drifts from the ceiling vents above them as a faint glow flickers off the table surface. The woman on the right slowly lifts her glass, takes a sip, and sets it back down. Her fingers twitch slightly at 2.40 seconds. At 3.15 seconds, she turns to look directly at the man dealing cards; her expression is unreadable but tense. She glances briefly toward the camera before shifting her gaze back to him with a slight frown. The man continues dealing as if nothing happened. At 4.60 seconds, he begins to shuffle more vigorously, causing some of the cards to scatter slightly off the table as they tumble into the air around him. The smoke swirls upward from unseen cigarettes nearby, obscuring part of the scene momentarily. By 5.70 seconds, the cards have been mostly gathered back together under his fingers. He looks down at them again and begins dealing another card toward the woman on the right with a slow, calculated motion. She doesn’t move — eyes locked on him as if trying to read his next move. The man continues dealing slowly, watching her face closely. At 7.20 seconds, she turns slightly left and looks off-camera for about one second before returning her gaze to him with a subtle smirk forming. The man continues dealing as if nothing happened — he doesn’t look away or pause. He watches her closely during this time. At 8.15 seconds, the cigarette smoke from above begins swirling around the table more visibly, curling up into thick plumes that obscure much of the scene and partially cover their faces. They both remain seated in place — she holds her hand open flat over the table, waiting for another card; he continues dealing slowly, watching her face closely. At 9.00 seconds, he deals one more card to her, then looks up briefly at something above them before turning back down and resuming shuffling.

en.text:
## LC Vision Caption 📝

**LC Vision Loader 🔬**:
- ⚠️ This auto downloads the model you choose on the first run, so it will take several minutes.
- The model selector shows your already downloaded options as well as available downloads.

**LC Vision Caption 📝**:
- 💡 The node analyzes the image and detects subject, pose, clothing, setting, lighting, color, composition, and mood, not just a one-line summary.
- Each reference gets its own label (`<Reference 1>`, `<Reference 2>`, `<Reference 3>`), described individually instead of mashed into one blob. 😎
- `style_tag` pushes the description toward a specific visual style regardless of what the reference actually looks like.

**💡 Analyzing 3 images at once**
- Custom prompt: "Analyze <Reference 1>, <Reference 2>, and <Reference 3> individually: describe each one's subject, setting, lighting, and mood. Then compare all three and note the key similarities and differences between them."
- The model addresses each picture by its own label instead of blending them together.

- The model selector shows your already downloaded options as well as available downloads.

**LC Vision Caption 📝**:
- 💡 The node analyzes the image and detects subject, pose, clothing, setting, lighting, color, composition, and mood, not just a one-line summary.
- Each reference gets its own label (`<Reference 1>`, `<Reference 2>`, `<Reference 3>`), described individually instead of mashed into one blob. 😎
- `style_tag` pushes the description toward a specific visual style regardless of what the reference actually looks like.

**💡 Analyzing 3 images at once**
- Custom prompt: "Analyze <Reference 1>, <Reference 2>, and <Reference 3> individually: describe each one's subject, setting, lighting, and mood. Then compare all three and note the key similarities and differences between them."
- The model addresses each picture by its own label instead of blending them together.

en.text:
## LC Vision Moviemaker 🎥

**LC Vision Loader 🔬**: 
- ⚠️ This auto downloads the model you choose on the first run, so it will take several minutes.
- The model selector shows your already downloaded options as well as available downloads.  

**LC Vision Moviemaker**: 
- Write your prompt, then select a preset (T2V, R2VA, FL2VA, etc.)
- Set **Duration** (seconds) with the slider to the left
   - on multiple prompt workflows, `segments` breaks it down into equal parts for continuation.
- 💡 **The multi-reference input**
   - This is what actually sets this node apart.
   - Use up to 4 reference images plus a reference video. It refers to each one individually instead of mushing them up into a blob. 😎
   - On **REF2VA**, list Image1, Image2, etc. in your prompt and the node does the work for you. 

**💡Low Vram**
- Use one of the 4b instruct gguf models.
- Lower the 'max_tokens' to about half. *note:* I suggest that you do not go below 1024 as the quality rapidly diminishes.

nodes.title: LC Vision Prompt Enhancer 📝

en.text:
## LC Vision Prompt Enhancer 📝

**LC Vision Loader 🔬**:
- ⚠️ This auto-downloads the model you choose on the first run, so it will take several minutes.
- The model selector shows your already downloaded options as well as available downloads.

**LC Vision Prompt Enhancer 📝**:
- Write your rough `prompt_text`, then pick a preset.
   - **Enhance**: adds detail, keeps your original intent.
   - **Refine**: cleans up wording and structure, adds nothing new.
   - **Creative Rewrite**: reimagines the scene around your subject.
   - **Detailed Visual**: maxes out concrete visual detail for photoreal output.
- Text-only, no image or video input needed. It works straight off the prompt.
- ⚠️ **Custom** preset needs an actual system prompt in `custom_system_prompt`. Leave it blank and it errors.
- 💡 **style_tag** locks the rewrite to a specific visual style on top of whatever the preset already does.

zh.text:
## LC Vision Prompt Enhancer 📝

**LC Vision Loader 🔬**：
- ⚠️ 首次运行会自动下载你选择的模型，所以要等几分钟。
- 模型选择器会同时显示你已下载的选项和可下载的选项。

**LC Vision Prompt Enhancer 📝**：
- 先写下粗略的 `prompt_text`，再选一个预设。
   - **Enhance**：增加细节，保留你的原意。
   - **Refine**：整理措辞和结构，不添加新内容。
   - **Creative Rewrite**：围绕你的主体重新构想场景。
   - **Detailed Visual**：把具体的视觉细节拉到最满，适合照片级输出。
- 纯文本，不需要图片或视频输入，直接根据提示词工作。
- ⚠️ **Custom** 预设需要在 `custom_system_prompt` 里填写真正的系统提示词。留空会报错。
- 💡 **style_tag** 会在预设已有效果的基础上，把改写锁定到某种特定的视觉风格。

- モデルセレクターには、ダウンロード済みのものとダウンロード可能なものが表示されます。

**LC Vision Prompt Enhancer 📝**:
- ざっくりした `prompt_text` を書いて、プリセットを選びます。
   - **Enhance**: ディテールを足しつつ、元の意図は保ちます。
   - **Refine**: 言い回しと構造を整えるだけで、何も足しません。
   - **Creative Rewrite**: 被写体を軸にシーンを作り直します。
   - **Detailed Visual**: フォトリアル向けに、具体的な視覚ディテールを最大限まで盛ります。
- テキストのみで、画像や動画の入力は不要です。プロンプトだけで動きます。
- ⚠️ **Custom** プリセットでは、`custom_system_prompt` に実際のシステムプロンプトが必要です。空だとエラーになります。
- 💡 **style_tag** は、プリセットの処理に加えて、書き換えを特定のビジュアルスタイルに固定します。

ko.text:
## LC Vision Prompt Enhancer 📝

**LC Vision Loader 🔬**:
- ⚠️ 처음 실행할 때 선택한 모델을 자동으로 다운로드하므로 몇 분 걸립니다.
- 모델 선택기에는 이미 다운로드한 옵션과 다운로드할 수 있는 옵션이 함께 표시됩니다.

**LC Vision Prompt Enhancer 📝**:
- 대충 `prompt_text`를 쓰고 프리셋을 고르세요.
   - **Enhance**: 디테일을 더하되 원래 의도는 유지합니다.
   - **Refine**: 표현과 구조를 다듬고, 새로운 내용은 추가하지 않습니다.
   - **Creative Rewrite**: 피사체를 중심으로 장면을 새로 구상합니다.
   - **Detailed Visual**: 포토리얼 출력을 위해 구체적인 시각 디테일을 최대로 끌어올립니다.
- 텍스트 전용이라 이미지나 영상 입력이 필요 없습니다. 프롬프트만으로 바로 작동합니다.
- ⚠️ **Custom** 프리셋은 `custom_system_prompt`에 실제 system prompt가 필요합니다. 비워 두면 에러가 납니다.
- 💡 **style_tag**는 프리셋이 이미 하는 일 위에, 다시 쓰기를 특정 비주얼 스타일로 고정합니다.

en.text:

### This is many hours of work. If you enjoy it, please 👍 like, 💬 comment, and feel free to ⚡ tip 😉

---

## LC Vision 🔬📝🎥: Why This Pack Doesn't Waste Your Time

Introduction: Getting a vision-capable llama.cpp build running is normally a multi-hour fight. Qwen-VL support (`Qwen3VLChatHandler` / `Qwen25VLChatHandler`) never got merged into upstream `llama-cpp-python`. It only lives in JamePeng's fork, shipped as raw GitHub Release wheels, one per exact Python version + CUDA version + OS combination. Get the match wrong and you get a bare import error, not a helpful one. This pack does that matching for you, automatically, before you've even opened a workflow.

**⚠️ install.py builds itself**
- Runs on its own the moment ComfyUI-Manager installs or updates this pack. You run nothing by hand.
- First checks whether a vision-capable `llama_cpp` is already importable. If it is, it does nothing and gets out of your way.
- If not, it reads your exact Python tag, OS, and CUDA version straight off your own machine, pulls JamePeng/llama-cpp-python's real GitHub Releases, and installs the one wheel that matches (rounding down to the closest CUDA version when there's no exact match).
- Snapshots `pip freeze` before touching anything, and only ever steps in on a real conflict `pip check` reports afterward, and only when `llama-cpp-python` itself is the package at fault, never someone else's pin. Everything else in your environment is left alone.
- Safe to re-run on every update. Idempotent by design, not by luck.

**How the Loader actually loads a model**
- `model_name` lists every `.gguf` + matching `mmproj` pair already sitting in `models/LLM`, plus a curated set of one-click downloads prefixed `⬇ Download:`.
- Pick a `⬇ Download:` entry and it pulls straight from HuggingFace on first use, then lands in that same folder. Next time it's just a normal option in the list.
- 💡 **What's curated right now**
   - **Qwen3-VL-4B-abliterated** and **Qwen3-VL-8B-abliterated**, each in **Q8_0** (smaller, faster) and **f16** (full precision). Four total, hand-picked instead of dumping an entire upstream catalog on you.
   - 4B is the video/Moviemaker pick, more headroom for multi-frame batches. 8B is the image/Caption pick, more fidelity.
   - mmproj always downloads at f16 regardless of the main model's quant. Vision quality leans on mmproj precision more than the LLM weights do.
- Once loaded, it stays loaded. ComfyUI's own node caching skips re-running the Loader entirely as long as its inputs haven't changed, same as a checkpoint loader. No reload tax between every Caption, Enhancer, or Moviemaker call.

Other vision-node packs hand you a requirements.txt and a wiki page telling you to go find the right wheel yourself. This one ships the fork detection, the CUDA matching, and the download baked in. Drop the node, pick a model, and it runs.

---

## Long videos 🎬
- **LC Vision Showrunner 🎬** and **LC Vision Shot List 📋** live in **LC H3 Showrunner Workflow V1.0.1** in this folder. The H3 side needs **LC AV**.
- **Shot List**: the story filled in like a form. 🧹 **Clear** empties it for the next project.

- ComfyUI-Manager가 이 팩을 설치하거나 업데이트하는 즉시 스스로 실행됩니다. 직접 실행할 것은 없습니다.
- 먼저 비전 지원 `llama_cpp`를 이미 import할 수 있는지 확인합니다. 가능하면 아무것도 하지 않고 비켜 줍니다.
- 그렇지 않으면 내 컴퓨터에서 정확한 Python 태그, OS, CUDA 버전을 읽고, JamePeng/llama-cpp-python의 실제 GitHub Releases를 가져와 맞는 wheel 하나를 설치합니다(정확히 일치하는 게 없으면 가장 가까운 낮은 CUDA 버전으로 내려갑니다).
- 아무것도 건드리기 전에 `pip freeze`를 스냅샷으로 남기고, 이후 `pip check`가 보고하는 실제 충돌이 있고 그 원인이 `llama-cpp-python` 자체일 때만 개입합니다. 다른 사람의 핀은 절대 건드리지 않습니다. 환경의 나머지는 그대로 둡니다.
- 업데이트할 때마다 다시 실행해도 안전합니다. 운이 아니라 설계상 멱등입니다.

**Loader가 실제로 모델을 불러오는 방식**
- `model_name`에는 `models/LLM`에 이미 있는 모든 `.gguf` + 짝이 되는 `mmproj` 쌍과, `⬇ Download:`로 시작하는 엄선된 원클릭 다운로드 항목이 나열됩니다.
- `⬇ Download:` 항목을 고르면 처음 사용할 때 HuggingFace에서 바로 받아 같은 폴더에 저장합니다. 다음부터는 그냥 목록의 일반 옵션이 됩니다.
- 💡 **현재 엄선된 항목**
   - **Qwen3-VL-4B-abliterated**와 **Qwen3-VL-8B-abliterated**, 각각 **Q8_0**(더 작고 빠름)과 **f16**(전체 정밀도). 총 4개이며, upstream 카탈로그 전체를 쏟아붓는 대신 직접 골랐습니다.
   - 4B는 비디오/Moviemaker용으로, 멀티 프레임 배치에 여유가 더 있습니다. 8B는 이미지/Caption용으로, 충실도가 더 높습니다.
   - mmproj는 메인 모델의 양자화와 상관없이 항상 f16으로 받습니다. 비전 품질은 LLM 가중치보다 mmproj 정밀도에 더 좌우됩니다.
- 한 번 불러오면 계속 로드된 상태로 유지됩니다. ComfyUI 자체 노드 캐싱이 입력이 바뀌지 않는 한 Loader 재실행을 완전히 건너뛰며, 체크포인트 로더와 같습니다. Caption, Enhancer, Moviemaker를 호출할 때마다 다시 로드하는 비용이 없습니다.

다른 비전 노드 팩들은 requirements.txt와 "맞는 wheel은 알아서 찾으세요"라는 위키 페이지를 건넵니다. 이 팩은 포크 감지, CUDA 매칭, 다운로드가 전부 내장되어 있습니다. 노드를 놓고, 모델을 고르면, 바로 돌아갑니다.

   - mmproj always downloads at f16 regardless of the main model's quant. Vision quality leans on mmproj precision more than the LLM weights do.
- Once loaded, it stays loaded. ComfyUI's own node caching skips re-running the Loader entirely as long as its inputs haven't changed, same as a checkpoint loader. No reload tax between every Caption, Enhancer, or Moviemaker call.

Other vision-node packs hand you a requirements.txt and a wiki page telling you to go find the right wheel yourself. This one ships the fork detection, the CUDA matching, and the download baked in. Drop the node, pick a model, and it runs.

---

## Long videos 🎬
- **LC Vision Showrunner 🎬** and **LC Vision Shot List 📋** live in **LC H3 Showrunner Workflow V1.0.1** in this folder. The H3 side needs **LC AV**.
- **Shot List**: the story filled in like a form. 🧹 **Clear** empties it for the next project.
- **Showrunner**: plans the movie as CUT / CONTINUE segments and fixes every join to how the last segment really ended.
    - **extend_segments**: a shot with a long line gets its own longer segment, up to 10 s.
    - 📂 **Load** / 💾 **Save**: the whole project (shot list, references, settings) in one `project.json`.

| **LC Face Crop 📐** | Crops to a format with the faces placed well instead of a blind centre crop, using the Aspect Ratio Simplifier presets. Framing from widest to face only. |
| **LC Flux 3 Klein AnyPaint 🩹** | The same inpaint and outpaint for Flux 3 Klein, painted in edit mode with AusBoss's Outpaint LoRA: the area is filled gray and the model fills it while your picture stays put. |
| **LC Image Blend Advance 🎚️** | Places a layer on a background (position, scale, rotate, mirror) and blends it with 29 blend modes through an optional mask. |
| **LC Krea2 AnyPaint 🩹** | Krea 2 inpaint and outpaint with the AnyPaint LoRA. Everything outside the mask comes back exactly as it was, and the seam disappears. |
| **LC Mask Refine ✨** | Tightens a mask with a trimap, using a guided filter or VITMatte on the edge band only, with a before/after wipe. |
| **LC Normal Map (BAE) 🗺️** | Makes a BAE surface normal map (RGB = XYZ), the same style ControlNet's normal_bae makes. |
| **LC Outpaint 🖌️➕** | Drag the canvas edges outward on the node to build a grey canvas and a mask of the new area. max_megapixels stops the edges at that size. |
| **LC Outpaint, Rotate, & Pad 🔄** | Turn, crop and pad a picture by dragging on the node, with a portrait / landscape flip. The mask covers the padding and the corners a turn opens up. max_megapixels stops the frame at that size. |
| **LC Person Mask 🧍** | Selects parts of a person (face, hair, body, clothes, accessories, background) with Segformer or MediaPipe. remove_features makes a skin-only mask. |
| **LC Remove Background ✂️** | Removes the background with BiRefNet and outputs an RGBA cutout, the mask and the subject on a solid color. |
| **LC SDXL AnyPaint 🩹** | The same inpaint and outpaint for any SDXL checkpoint (SDXL, Pony, Illustrious), painted by ControlNet Union ProMax, Fooocus inpaint optional. No LoRA needed. |
| **LC Segment Anything 🎯** | Selects things by describing them, using GroundingDINO + SAM or SAM 3, with optional edge refine. |
| **LC Smart Detailer (pipe) 🩹** | The same, with model, VAE and sampler settings from the LC pipe. A wired model or VAE overrides the pipe's. |
| **LC Smart Detailer 🩹** | Replaces the SEGS / Impact detailers. Finds what you type (hands, face, eyes) with SAM 3 and redraws each one in its own upscaled crop, then blends it back in. |
| **LC VOSR2 Upscale (pipe) 🧩** | The same on the LC pipe, after the pipe detailers. Carries the detailers' areas to the new size (protected output) for LC Skin Upscale / LC Skin Texture. |
| **LC VOSR2 Upscale 🧩** | Fast, low-VRAM upscale with VOSR 2.0, built in: sharpens and adds fine detail without redrawing the picture. 1.5x to 4x in one pass, 6x and 8x in two. |
| **LC Z-Image AnyPaint 🩹** | The same inpaint and outpaint for Z-Image (Turbo / Base), painted by the Z-Image Fun ControlNet Union 2.1 patch instead of a LoRA. Everything outside the mask comes back exactly as it was. |

---

## LC Vision v1.6.0

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_Vision_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_Vision_nodes)

| Node | What it does |
|---|---|
| **LC Vision Caption 📝** | Generates text from a loaded LC Vision model, an instruction, up to three reference images and a reference video. |
| **LC Vision Danbooru Caption 🏷️** | Prompts for SDXL, Pony and Illustrious from one image or a rough idea: a short or detailed caption, real Danbooru tags, or a sentence plus tags. Optional quality tags and a matching negative. |
| **LC Vision Loader 🔬** | Loads a Qwen-VL GGUF model and its vision projector. keep_model_loaded off unloads it after the Vision nodes are done, so the image model gets the whole card. |
| **LC Vision Moviemaker 🎥** | Plans a video as several continuous segments in one call, each written as a self-contained MiniMax H3 prompt. |
| **LC Vision Prompt Enhancer 📝** | Rewrites a prompt through an LC Vision model using a preset instruction (text only). |
| **LC Vision Redirect (BETA) 🔬** | Kept for older workflows: LC Vision Showrunner now fixes the joins itself. |
| **LC Vision Reviewer 🕵️ (BETA)** | Quality gate: yes/no checks on hands, faces, text, artifacts, prompt match and your own questions. Flags a bad render, or blocks everything after it. |
| **LC Vision Shot List (BETA) 📋** | The story for the Showrunner, filled in like a form: the place, the cast and one row per shot. Suggests the segment count and warns about lines too long for their shot. No AI involved. |
| **LC Vision Showrunner (BETA) 🎬** | Plans a long MiniMax H3 video as CUT / CONTINUE segments, fixes each join to how the last segment really ended, and saves / loads the project file (shot list, references, settings). |

---

## LC ModelBuilder v0.6.3

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_ModelBuilder_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_ModelBuilder_nodes)

| Node | What it does |
|---|---|
| **LC Checkpoint Save** | Saves an all-in-one checkpoint (model, clip, vae) with an enabled toggle to skip the save. metadata: keep all, or necessary only (no workflow or training details). |
| **LC Diffusion Model Save** | Saves just the diffusion model, with no clip or vae. Same metadata switch. |
| **LC Face Variety Scorer 🧑‍🤝‍🧑** | Scores how alike the faces in a batch are (0 to 1, lower = more variety), plus a crowd score for group shots. Photo (ArcFace) or anime (CCIP) mode. |
| **LC Fingerprint Identify 🔎** | What is this model made of? Its recipe from your fingerprint library, block by block: which models were merged and at what ratio, merged-in LoRAs with their strength, how sure it is of each, and a heatmap. It can only name what is in the library. |
| **LC Fingerprint Library 📚** | Goes through your folders and stores a small fingerprint (about 1 MB) of every model and LoRA, with its family. Once a file is in, the original can go. Reruns only add what is new. |
| **LC Krea2 Block Merge Advanced** | Merges Krea2 checkpoints with a draggable per-block ratio curve across the 28 blocks plus sliders for the named regions. |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA Block ScanBETA** | Finds where a LoRA locks the face or changes the whole image by turning off one block group at a time, and suggests a block curve for the Editor. |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA EditorBETA** | Loads a Krea 2 LoRA with each of the 28 blocks turned up or down, attention and MLP scaled separately, and spikes softened. |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA MergeBETA** | Merges two to four Krea 2 LoRAs with a per-block A / B curve (sum or TIES). |
| **LC Krea2 Semantic Vector Tuner** | Amplifies or attenuates specific regions of a single Krea2 checkpoint's weights (not a merge). |
| **LC LoRA Extract** | Turns a finetune into a LoRA (finetuned minus its base): all layers, blocks only or a custom block list. Unchanged layers are left out. |
| **LC LoRA SaveBETA** | Saves an edited or merged LoRA as a standard file with every edit baked in, optionally at a new rank, with enabled and embed_workflow switches. |
| **LC Model Fingerprint 🔍** | One model against a reference, layer by layer, from the weights themselves: the same model at another precision, built on it, a block merge (the chart shows which blocks) or not related. With a LoRA: whether it was merged in and at about what strength. |
| **LC Model Merge (any precision)** | Merges two models stored in different precisions (bf16 with fp8, int8, nvfp4 or GGUF, in either order). The result stays full precision. |
| **LC Model Quantize 🗜️** | Saves a smaller copy of a model: fp8, mxfp8, nvfp4, int8 or int4 (load with the stock loader) or GGUF Q8_0 to Q2_K. From the wired MODEL (LoRAs baked in) or straight from a file of any size. |
| **LC Scoreboard 🏆** | Head-to-head counter for A / B tests: #1 Win, Tie and #2 Win buttons, with the leader and percentages shown on the node. |
| **LC Strip Metadata 🧹** | Cleans the metadata out of a model you already saved (embedded workflow, training details, titles). The weights are copied byte for byte, never loaded, so it loads exactly as before. Writes a _clean copy or replaces the original. |
| **LC VAE Compare** | Decodes the same latents with up to six VAEs, side by side with a 1:1 detail crop, a sharpness number and how far each lands from the first. |
| **LC VAE Merge** | Merges the decoders of two VAEs of the same family, coarse shapes to fine texture. The encoder stays the base's, so the result still fits the models made for it. |
| **LC VAE Save** | Saves a VAE to models/vae in fp32, bf16 or fp16. |

## LC123 v1.51.3

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes)

| 节点 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| **CivitAI 🚩🔪** | 根据合规列表从提示词中剔除被标记的词，仅作辅助（你仍需自行对 CivitAI 的条款负责）。你打开之前它是关闭的。 |
| **LC Advanced Folder 📂** | 为 Image Saver 类节点分别生成文件名和路径输出，可选在路径中加入前缀和时间戳。 |
| **LC Anima Regional Inline Canvas** | 在节点上绘制 RGB 区域，为每个区域得到独立的 conditioning 和蒙版，用于 Anima 的分区提示。 |
| **LC Any Empty Bool** | 只要任何一个连接的输入为空、被静音或被绕过，就输出 true。 |
| **LC Any Empty Float** | 执行与 Any Empty Bool 相同的判空，输出一个 empty 浮点数和一个 not-empty 浮点数。 |
| **LC Any Empty Int** | 执行与 Any Empty Bool 相同的判空，输出一个 empty 整数和一个 not-empty 整数。 |
| **LC Any Index Switch** | 透传所选索引处的输入，忽略其他槽位。 |
| **LC AnySwitch** | 从 2 到 20 个输入中选取第一个已连接的，并锁定为它的类型。 |
| **LC Apply LoRA Stack 🎚️** | 把 LC LoRA Loader Stack（或任何节点包）输出的 LORA_STACK 应用到 model 和/或 clip。 |
| **LC Apply LUT** | 应用 models/luts 中的 .cube 3D LUT，强度 0 到 2。默认使用 LC Crushed Blacks，强度 0.3。 |
| **LC Aspect Ratio Pipe (In/Edit)** | 把 image、mask、size、latent、batch 和分辨率打包进 LC_PIPE，或编辑已有的 pipe，只覆盖已连线的接口。 |
| **LC Aspect Ratio Pipe Out** | 把 LC_PIPE 中的宽高比字段拆成独立接口，并继续传递 pipe。 |
| **LC Auto White Balance** | 自动校正白平衡，可选算法、强度混合以及前后对比擦除。 |
| **LC Basic Scheduler** | 输出完整步数的 sigma（不含 denoise），用来喂给 LC Split Sigmas (Advanced) 做双遍采样。 |
| **LC Batch Image 🖼️** | 从自动增长的槽位批处理图片，忽略静音或缺失的，并把后面的图片缩放到与第一张一致。 |
| **LC Bloom** | 从亮部生成辉光，有 Bloom、Pro-Mist（柔光滤镜）或 Halation（胶片边缘光晕）模式。 |
| **LC Boolean** | 把布尔值、整数或浮点数转成干净的 true/false，并显示在节点上。 |
| **LC Boolean Flip** | 输出其开关的相反值。 |
| **LC Boolean Switch** | 根据布尔值选择 on_true 或 on_false 输入（任意类型）。 |
| **LC Boolean Value** | 一个可以连到任何地方的普通布尔开关。 |
| **LC Bounding Boxes 🔲** | 在图上画框用于 Flux 3：给每个框命名，选择 new、change、move 或 remove，并描述结果。经典界面和 Nodes 2.0 都能用。 |
| **LC Bypass Relay** | 收集它左边的节点，让枢纽节点通过 OPT_CONNECTION 一次性静音或绕过它们全部。 |
| **LC Bypasser PanelJS only** | 仅含控件的遥控器，用于 LC Bypasser、LC Mute 或 LC Groups Bypasser。 |
| **LC BypasserJS only** | 通过开关或 BOOLEAN 输入，在一个地方绕过相连的节点。 |
| **LC Chromatic Aberration** | 把 RGB 通道错开来模拟镜头色边，可按通道设置像素量和方向。 |
| **LC Color Match 🎨** | 把图像的颜色匹配到参考图（AdaIN / mean-std），可选皮肤保护和蒙版。 |
| **LC Combo Selector** | 一个下拉菜单，接入另一个节点的 combo（采样器、调度器等）后，会镜像其选项。 |
| **LC Control Panel 🎛️** | 一个节点上最多 16 个滑块和开关，每个都有自己的输出。点行上的齿轮可以设置类型（数字或布尔）、名称、范围、步长以及 INT 或 FLOAT。把新的一行接到某个数字或布尔输入上，会复制该输入的设置。 |
| **LC Custom Combo** | 建立你自己的选项列表，输出所选文本及其索引。 |
| **LC Custom Combo Panel** | 一个遥控器，可以在别处为 LC Custom Combo 选择选项。 |
| **LC Denoise 💉** | 注入 latent 噪声，强度按 1 减去你的 denoise 值缩放，使用的 denoise 和你给采样器的一样。 |
| **LC Depth FX 🌫️** | 用深度图生成大气雾化、光线环绕和带真实焦外虚化的景深，带共享的风格。 |
| **LC Detail Daemon (BETA)** | 在若干步数的窗口内向模型隐藏一点噪声来增加细微细节，沿用原版 Detail Daemon 的 schedule。有 look only（默认）、classic 和 keep structure 模式。采样器版本。放在 low pass 采样器上。 |
| **LC Detail Daemon (model) (BETA)** | 同一个 Detail Daemon，做成 model patch，用于普通 KSampler。 |
| **LC Detail Pipe Out** | 从 LC_PIPE 中拆出 detailer 设置（models、prompts、seed、cfg、sampler、scheduler、steps）。protect_mask（底部）：pipe detailer 重绘过的区域。 |
| **LC Dimension Resize 📐** | 用一个数值对宽和高做加、减、乘或除，并把结果取整。 |
| **LC Directional Blur** | 沿某个角度和长度的运动模糊，通过拖动节点上的箭头设置。 |
| **LC Dynamic Overlay** | 把图 B 叠在图 A 上，运行一次后可直接在节点上调整不透明度，无需重新生成。 |
| **LC Easy Folder 📂** | 为原生 Save Image 节点生成 filename_prefix 并创建文件夹。 |
| **LC Film Grain** | 添加胶片颗粒，可设数量、对比度、大小以及黑白或彩色。 |
| **LC Film Grain (Video) 🎞️** | 整段视频使用同一种颗粒：GPU 每次处理几帧，带进度条。颗粒按视频尺寸生成，压缩后依然保留。 |
| **LC Film Stock (B&W)** | 通过预设和强度混合，营造黑白胶片的质感。 |
| **LC Film Stock (Color)** | 通过预设（toe、shoulder、gamma）和强度混合，营造彩色胶片的质感。 |
| **LC Float Compare** | 输出两个浮点数中较大或较小的一个。 |
| **LC Flux 3 Layout Prompt 🗺️** | 把框以模型训练时所用的表格形式加进 Flux 3 提示词。在提示词里写 <1>、<2> 分别代表框 1、框 2。 |
| **LC Flux 3 Reference Latent 🖼️** | 为 Flux 3 的正面和负面提供最多 4 张参考图，以及模型需要的负面和 latent 尺寸。 |
| **LC Get Image 📐** | 读取图像的宽、高、百万像素、长边、批大小和宽高比。 |
| **LC Groups BypasserJS only** | 在一个地方绕过整个组，每个组一个开关。 |
| **LC Image Adjust** | 基础调色（色相、饱和度、亮度、对比度），带轻微锐化或柔化。 |
| **LC Image Batch From Folder 📂** | 按字母顺序把整个文件夹加载为一个批次，带 max_images 和 start_index。 |
| **LC Image Compare 🔎** | 用紧凑的下拉菜单和稳定的图像区域对比大批量图片。 |
| **LC Image Crop 🖼️🔪** | 通过在节点上拖动框和控制点来裁剪，可选比例锁定。 |
| **LC Image Denoise** | 智能去噪，带模糊强度、边缘保留和混合。 |
| **LC Image Desaturate** | 向灰度去饱和，可选系数和亮度方法。 |
| **LC Image Grid 🖼️** | 把一批图片排成网格，可选间距、轮廓和边框。 |
| **LC Image Label** | 浮动的图片贴纸，支持拖放上传，用来给工作流做标注（没有接口）。 |
| **LC Image Pass** | 让图片直接通过，它的启用开关可以静音下游挂在它后面的内容。 |
| **LC Image Ref Pipe In 🖼️** | 把最多 16 张参考图打包进一个 pipe，接口会像 Text Encode Qwen Image 2.1 那样自动增长。 |
| **LC Image Ref Pipe Out 🖼️** | 把图片参考 pipe 还原为 image_1 到 image_16，各回原位，pipe 在最前。 |
| **LC Image RGB** | 分别偏移每个颜色通道，带整体强度。 |
| **LC Image Split 🖼️** | 节点上的前后对比擦除，输出的是合成好的分割图，可用于保存。 |
| **LC Image Stitch Multi 🖼️🪡** | 通过自动增长的槽位把图片并排或上下拼接，带 match size、对齐和可选间距。 |
| **LC Image to Total Megapixels 📐** | 把图像缩放到指定的总百万像素，并输出得到的分辨率。 |
| **LC Image-Mask Resize 📐** | 把图像和/或蒙版缩放到预设、自定义尺寸、倍数或百万像素数，尺寸为 divisible_by 的倍数。 |

| **LC Int Split** | 按小数分割点把总数拆成 a + b，所以 a + b 永远等于总数。 |
| **LC Invert Boolean** | 把布尔值、整数或浮点数转成布尔，并输出其相反值。 |
| **LC Is Bypassed / Muted** | 如果连入的节点被绕过或静音就输出 true，实时读取，无需排队。 |
| **LC Join Strings 🔗** | 用分隔符连接多个字符串，并跳过空的。 |
| **LC Krea2 Regional Inline Canvas** | 在节点上绘制 RGB 区域，使用 krea2 CLIP 类型得到分区 conditioning。 |
| **LC Label 🏷️** | 浮动的文字标签，用来给工作流做标注，可设字体、颜色、描边和阴影（没有接口）。 |
| **LC Last Image Holder** | 保留上一张生成的图片用于前后对比，即使断开连接也在。Hold until seed change 会保留某个种子的第一张图，用来对比后续调整。 |
| **LC Lens FX (deprecated)deprecated** | 搜索中已隐藏。旧工作流仍能运行。请改用 Lens Profile、Vignette 和 Film Grain。 |
| **LC Lens Profile** | 应用或校正一个命名的镜头配置文件，强度可调。 |
| **LC Lift Gamma Gain** | 用 lift、gamma、gain 和 offset 对阴影、中间调和高光调色。 |
| **LC Lighting Control V2 🔦** | 用一到两个聚光灯或太阳光、色温、色片以及硬或软投影，给图像重新打光。 |

| **LC MiniMax H3 Pipe Out** | 把 LC MiniMax H3 pipe 拆成独立接口。 |

| **LC Model Optimizer Video (pipe) ⚡** | 与 LC Model Optimizer Video 相同，另外多一个 LC_PIPE 输出（vae 2 携带音频 VAE）。 |
| **LC Model Optimizer Video ⚡** | 视频版本：为 MiniMax H3 和 LTX 2.5 / 2.3 提供模型、文本编码器、视频与音频 VAE 以及 latent 放大器。 |

| **LC Face Variety Scorer 🧑‍🤝‍🧑** | 评估一个批次中的人脸有多相似（0 到 1，越低 = 越多样），并为合影给出人群分数。有照片（ArcFace）或动漫（CCIP）模式。 |
| **LC Fingerprint Identify 🔎** | 这个模型是由什么构成的？根据你的指纹库，逐个 block 给出它的配方：合并了哪些模型、比例多少，合并进去的 LoRA 及其强度，对每一项有多确定，以及热力图。它只能识别库里已有的东西。 |
| **LC Fingerprint Library 📚** | 遍历你的文件夹，为每个模型和 LoRA 保存一个小指纹（约 1 MB）及其所属家族。文件入库后，原文件就可以删除。重新运行只会添加新增的内容。 |
| **LC Krea2 Block Merge Advanced** | 合并 Krea2 checkpoint，在 28 个 block 上使用可拖动的逐 block 比例曲线，另有针对命名区域的滑块。 |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA Block ScanBETA** | 通过逐个关闭一组 block，找出 LoRA 在哪里锁定人脸或改变整幅图像，并为 Editor 建议一条 block 曲线。 |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA EditorBETA** | 加载 Krea 2 LoRA，可对 28 个 block 逐个调高或调低，attention 和 MLP 分别缩放，并柔化尖峰。 |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA MergeBETA** | 用逐 block 的 A / B 曲线合并两到四个 Krea 2 LoRA（求和或 TIES）。 |
| **LC Krea2 Semantic Vector Tuner** | 放大或衰减单个 Krea2 checkpoint 权重的特定区域（不是合并）。 |
| **LC LoRA Extract** | 把 finetune 变成 LoRA（finetuned 减去其 base）：全部层、仅 blocks 或自定义 block 列表。没有变化的层会被省略。 |
| **LC LoRA SaveBETA** | 把编辑或合并后的 LoRA 保存为标准文件，所有编辑都已烘焙进去，可选新的 rank，带 enabled 和 embed_workflow 开关。 |
| **LC Model Fingerprint 🔍** | 把一个模型与参考模型逐层对比，直接从权重本身判断：是同一模型的另一种精度、基于它构建、block 合并（图表会显示是哪些 block）还是毫无关系。配合 LoRA 时：是否被合并进去，以及大约的强度。 |
| **LC Model Merge (any precision)** | 合并以不同精度存储的两个模型（bf16 与 fp8、int8、nvfp4 或 GGUF，顺序不限）。结果保持全精度。 |
| **LC Model Quantize 🗜️** | 保存模型的较小副本：fp8、mxfp8、nvfp4、int8 或 int4（用原生加载器加载）或 GGUF Q8_0 到 Q2_K。来源可以是接入的 MODEL（LoRA 已烘焙），也可以直接是任意大小的文件。 |
| **LC Scoreboard 🏆** | A / B 测试的对战计分器：#1 Win、Tie 和 #2 Win 按钮，领先者和百分比显示在节点上。 |
| **LC Strip Metadata 🧹** | 清除你已保存模型里的元数据（内嵌工作流、训练细节、标题）。权重按字节原样复制，从不加载，所以加载效果与之前完全一致。写出一个 _clean 副本或替换原文件。 |
| **LC VAE Compare** | 用最多六个 VAE 解码同样的 latent，并排显示，带 1:1 细节裁剪、锐度数值，以及每个离第一个有多远。 |
| **LC VAE Merge** | 合并同一家族两个 VAE 的解码器，从粗略形状到精细纹理。编码器仍然是 base 的，所以结果依然适配为它制作的模型。 |
| **LC VAE Save** | 以 fp32、bf16 或 fp16 把 VAE 保存到 models/vae。 |

---

| **LC Boolean Switch** | boolean に応じて、on_true または on_false の入力（任意の型）を選びます。 |

| **LC Bounding Boxes 🔲** | Flux 3 用に、画像上にボックスを描きます。ボックスに名前を付け、new、change、move、remove から選び、結果を説明します。classic と Nodes 2.0 の両方で動きます。 |

| **LC Bypasser PanelJS only** | LC Bypasser、LC Mute、LC Groups Bypasser 用の、ウィジェットだけのリモコンです。 |
| **LC BypasserJS only** | トグルまたは BOOLEAN 入力で、リンクされたノードを一か所からバイパスします。 |

| **LC Vision Showrunner (BETA) 🎬** | 長い MiniMax H3 動画を CUT / CONTINUE のセグメントとして計画し、直前のセグメントが実際にどう終わったかに合わせて各つなぎ目を修正し、プロジェクトファイル（ショットリスト、リファレンス、設定）を保存／読み込みします。 |

---

## LC ModelBuilder v0.6.3

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_ModelBuilder_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_ModelBuilder_nodes)

| ノード | 機能 |
|---|---|
| **LC Checkpoint Save** | オールインワンのチェックポイント（model、clip、vae）を保存します。enabled トグルで保存をスキップできます。metadata: すべて保持、または必要最小限のみ（ワークフローや学習の詳細なし）。 |
| **LC Diffusion Model Save** | clip や vae なしで、diffusion model だけを保存します。metadata のスイッチは同じです。 |
| **LC Face Variety Scorer 🧑‍🤝‍🧑** | バッチ内の顔がどれだけ似ているかをスコア化し（0 から 1、低いほどバラエティがある）、集合写真用のクラウドスコアも出します。写真（ArcFace）またはアニメ（CCIP）モードがあります。 |
| **LC Fingerprint Identify 🔎** | このモデルは何でできている？ フィンガープリントライブラリから、ブロックごとにそのレシピを割り出します: どのモデルがどの比率でマージされたか、マージされた LoRA とその強度、それぞれの確信度、そしてヒートマップ。ライブラリにあるものしか名指しできません。 |
| **LC Fingerprint Library 📚** | フォルダを巡回して、すべてのモデルと LoRA の小さなフィンガープリント（約1 MB）を、ファミリーとともに保存します。一度登録すれば、元のファイルは削除できます。再実行すると新しいものだけが追加されます。 |
| **LC Krea2 Block Merge Advanced** | Krea2 のチェックポイントを、28ブロックにわたるドラッグ可能なブロックごとの比率カーブと、名前付き領域用のスライダーでマージします。 |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA Block ScanBETA** | ブロックグループを1つずつオフにして、LoRA が顔をロックしている場所や画像全体を変えている場所を見つけ、Editor 用のブロックカーブを提案します。 |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA EditorBETA** | 28ブロックそれぞれを上げ下げし、attention と MLP を別々にスケールして、スパイクを和らげた状態で Krea 2 LoRA を読み込みます。 |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA MergeBETA** | 2から4個の Krea 2 LoRA を、ブロックごとの A / B カーブ（sum または TIES）でマージします。 |
| **LC Krea2 Semantic Vector Tuner** | 単一の Krea2 チェックポイントの重みの特定の領域を増幅または減衰させます（マージではありません）。 |
| **LC LoRA Extract** | ファインチューンを LoRA（ファインチューン - ベース）に変換します: all layers、blocks only、またはカスタムのブロックリスト。変化のないレイヤーは除外されます。 |
| **LC LoRA SaveBETA** | 編集またはマージした LoRA を、すべての編集を焼き込んだ標準ファイルとして保存します。新しい rank を指定することもでき、enabled と embed_workflow のスイッチがあります。 |
| **LC Model Fingerprint 🔍** | 1つのモデルをリファレンスと、重みそのものからレイヤーごとに比較します: 同じモデルの別の精度、その上に作られたもの、ブロックマージ（チャートでどのブロックか分かる）、または無関係か。LoRA の場合は、マージされているか、おおよそどの強度かを調べます。 |
| **LC Model Merge (any precision)** | 異なる精度で保存された2つのモデル（bf16 と fp8、int8、nvfp4、GGUF の組み合わせ。順序は問わない）をマージします。結果はフル精度のままです。 |
| **LC Model Quantize 🗜️** | モデルの小さなコピーを保存します: fp8、mxfp8、nvfp4、int8、int4（標準のローダーで読み込み）、または GGUF の Q8_0 から Q2_K。接続した MODEL（LoRA 焼き込み済み）から、またはどんなサイズのファイルからも直接作れます。 |
| **LC Scoreboard 🏆** | A / B テスト用の対戦カウンター: #1 Win、Tie、#2 Win のボタンがあり、ノード上にリーダーとパーセンテージが表示されます。 |
| **LC Strip Metadata 🧹** | すでに保存したモデルからメタデータ（埋め込まれたワークフロー、学習の詳細、タイトル）を取り除きます。重みはバイト単位でコピーされ、読み込まれることはないので、以前とまったく同じように読み込めます。_clean コピーを書き出すか、元のファイルを置き換えます。 |
| **LC VAE Compare** | 最大6つの VAE で同じ latent をデコードし、1:1 のディテールクロップ、シャープネス値、最初のものからどれだけ離れているかとともに、並べて表示します。 |
| **LC VAE Merge** | 同じファミリーの2つの VAE のデコーダーを、粗い形から細かい質感までマージします。エンコーダーはベースのものが残るので、結果はそのために作られたモデルにそのまま合います。 |
| **LC VAE Save** | VAE を fp32、bf16、fp16 で models/vae に保存します。 |

---
"True Nothing is. Permitted Everything is"- Yoda Auditore, Assassin's Wars

## LC123 v1.51.3

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes)

| 노드 | 기능 |
|---|---|
| **CivitAI 🚩🔪** | 준수 목록을 기준으로 프롬프트에서 신고 대상 용어를 제거합니다. 보조 도구일 뿐이며 (CivitAI 약관에 대한 책임은 여전히 본인에게 있습니다). 켜기 전에는 꺼져 있습니다. |
| **LC Advanced Folder 📂** | Image Saver 스타일 노드를 위해 파일명과 경로 출력을 따로 만들어 줍니다. prefix-in-path와 timestamp는 선택 사항입니다. |
| **LC Anima Regional Inline Canvas** | 노드 위에 RGB 영역을 칠하면 영역마다 별도의 conditioning과 마스크를 만들어 줍니다. Anima regional prompting용입니다. |
| **LC Any Empty Bool** | 연결된 입력 중 하나라도 비어 있거나, 뮤트되었거나, 바이패스되었으면 true를 출력합니다. |
| **LC Any Empty Float** | Any Empty Bool과 같은 빈 값 검사를 실행해서 empty와 not-empty float를 출력합니다. |
| **LC Any Empty Int** | Any Empty Bool과 같은 빈 값 검사를 실행해서 empty와 not-empty 정수를 출력합니다. |
| **LC Any Index Switch** | 선택한 인덱스의 입력을 통과시키고 다른 슬롯은 무시합니다. |
| **LC AnySwitch** | 2~20개 입력 중 처음으로 연결된 것을 골라서 그 타입으로 고정됩니다. |
| **LC Apply LoRA Stack 🎚️** | LC LoRA Loader Stack(또는 다른 팩)의 LORA_STACK을 model 및/또는 clip에 적용합니다. |
| **LC Apply LUT** | models/luts의 .cube 3D LUT을 0~2 strength로 적용합니다. LC Crushed Blacks를 0.3으로 시작합니다. |
| **LC Aspect Ratio Pipe (In/Edit)** | 이미지, 마스크, 크기, latent, 배치, 해상도를 LC_PIPE에 담거나, 기존 pipe를 편집합니다. 연결된 소켓만 덮어씁니다. |
| **LC Aspect Ratio Pipe Out** | LC_PIPE의 aspect ratio 필드를 별도 소켓으로 풀고 pipe는 그대로 넘깁니다. |
| **LC Auto White Balance** | 알고리즘 선택, strength 블렌드, 전/후 와이프로 화이트 밸런스를 자동으로 보정합니다. |
| **LC Basic Scheduler** | 전체 step 수(denoise 없음)에 대한 sigma를 출력하며, 듀얼 패스 샘플링을 위해 LC Split Sigmas (Advanced)에 넣도록 만들었습니다. |
| **LC Batch Image 🖼️** | 자동으로 늘어나는 슬롯에서 이미지를 배치로 묶습니다. 뮤트되었거나 없는 슬롯은 무시하고, 뒤의 이미지는 첫 번째 크기에 맞춰 리사이즈합니다. |
| **LC Bloom** | Bloom, Pro-Mist(디퓨전 필터), Halation(필름 가장자리 글로우) 모드로 밝은 영역에서 번지는 빛을 추가합니다. |
| **LC Boolean** | boolean, int, float를 깔끔한 true/false로 바꾸고 노드에 표시합니다. |
| **LC Boolean Flip** | 토글의 반대값을 출력합니다. |
| **LC Boolean Switch** | boolean에 따라 on_true 또는 on_false 입력(모든 타입)을 고릅니다. |
| **LC Boolean Value** | 어디에든 연결할 수 있는 단순한 boolean 토글입니다. |
| **LC Bounding Boxes 🔲** | Flux 3용으로 그림 위에 박스를 그립니다: 박스마다 이름을 붙이고, new, change, move, remove 중에서 고르고, 결과를 설명하세요. classic과 Nodes 2.0 모두에서 작동합니다. |
| **LC Bypass Relay** | 왼쪽의 노드들을 모아서, 허브가 OPT_CONNECTION을 통해 전부 함께 뮤트하거나 바이패스할 수 있게 합니다. |
| **LC Bypasser PanelJS only** | LC Bypasser, LC Mute, LC Groups Bypasser용 위젯 전용 리모컨입니다. |
| **LC BypasserJS only** | 토글이나 BOOLEAN 입력으로 연결된 노드를 한곳에서 바이패스합니다. |
| **LC Chromatic Aberration** | RGB 채널을 어긋나게 해서 렌즈 색수차를 흉내 냅니다. 채널별 픽셀 양과 방향을 지정할 수 있습니다. |
| **LC Color Match 🎨** | 이미지의 색을 참조에 맞춥니다 (AdaIN / mean-std). 피부 보호와 마스크는 선택 사항입니다. |
| **LC Combo Selector** | 다른 노드의 combo(sampler, scheduler 등)에 연결하면 그 옵션을 그대로 보여 주는 드롭다운입니다. |
| **LC Control Panel 🎛️** | 한 노드에 슬라이더와 on/off 스위치가 최대 16개 있고, 각각 자기 출력이 있습니다. 행의 톱니바퀴에서 타입(숫자 또는 boolean), 이름, 범위, step, INT 또는 FLOAT를 설정합니다. 숫자나 boolean 입력에 연결한 새 행은 그 입력의 설정을 복사합니다. |
| **LC Custom Combo** | 나만의 옵션 목록을 만들고, 선택한 텍스트와 그 인덱스를 출력합니다. |
| **LC Custom Combo Panel** | 다른 위치에서 LC Custom Combo의 선택을 고르는 리모컨입니다. |
| **LC Denoise 💉** | sampler에 주는 것과 같은 denoise 값을 사용해서, 1에서 denoise를 뺀 만큼의 latent 노이즈를 주입합니다. |
| **LC Depth FX 🌫️** | depth map으로 대기 안개, light wrap, 진짜 보케가 있는 피사계 심도를 만듭니다. 공유 룩이 있습니다. |
| **LC Detail Daemon (BETA)** | 원래 Detail Daemon 스케줄에 따라 일부 step 구간에서 모델에게 노이즈를 조금 숨겨서 미세한 디테일을 더합니다. Look only(기본), classic, keep structure 모드. Sampler 버전. low pass sampler에 연결합니다. |
| **LC Detail Daemon (model) (BETA)** | 같은 Detail Daemon을 일반 KSampler용 model 패치로 만든 것입니다. |
| **LC Detail Pipe Out** | LC_PIPE에서 detailer 설정(모델, 프롬프트, seed, cfg, sampler, scheduler, steps)을 풉니다. protect_mask (맨 아래): pipe detailer가 다시 그린 영역. |
| **LC Dimension Resize 📐** | 가로와 세로에 값 하나를 더하거나, 빼거나, 곱하거나, 나누고 결과를 정수로 반올림합니다. |
| **LC Directional Blur** | 노드의 화살표를 드래그해서 정하는 각도와 길이로 모션 블러를 적용합니다. |
| **LC Dynamic Overlay** | 이미지 B를 이미지 A 위에 겹치고, 한 번 실행한 뒤에는 다시 생성하지 않고도 노드에서 불투명도를 조절할 수 있습니다. |
| **LC Easy Folder 📂** | 기본 Save Image 노드용 filename_prefix를 만들고 폴더를 생성합니다. |
| **LC Film Grain** | amount, contrast, size, 모노/컬러 옵션으로 필름 그레인을 추가합니다. |
| **LC Film Grain (Video) 🎞️** | 클립 전체에 같은 그레인을 적용합니다: GPU에서 몇 프레임씩 처리하고 진행 표시줄이 나옵니다. 그레인을 영상 크기에 맞춰서 압축 후에도 살아남습니다. |
| **LC Film Stock (B&W)** | 프리셋과 strength 블렌드로 흑백 필름 룩을 만듭니다. |
| **LC Film Stock (Color)** | 프리셋(toe, shoulder, gamma)과 strength 블렌드로 컬러 필름 룩을 만듭니다. |
| **LC Float Compare** | 두 float 중 큰 쪽 또는 작은 쪽을 출력합니다. |
| **LC Flux 3 Layout Prompt 🗺️** | 모델이 학습된 표 형식으로 박스를 Flux 3 프롬프트에 추가합니다. 프롬프트에 <1>, <2>라고 쓰면 박스 1, 박스 2를 가리킵니다. |
| **LC Flux 3 Reference Latent 🖼️** | Flux 3용 레퍼런스 그림을 최대 4장까지 positive와 negative에 붙이고, 모델이 필요로 하는 negative와 latent 크기를 만들어 줍니다. |
| **LC Get Image 📐** | 이미지의 가로, 세로, 메가픽셀, 긴 변, 배치 크기, 종횡비를 읽습니다. |
| **LC Groups BypasserJS only** | 그룹마다 토글 하나씩으로, 그룹 전체를 한곳에서 바이패스합니다. |
| **LC Image Adjust** | 기본 컬러 그레이드(hue, saturation, brightness, contrast)에 약한 샤픈 또는 소프트닝이 있습니다. |
| **LC Image Batch From Folder 📂** | 폴더 전체를 알파벳 순서로 하나의 배치로 불러옵니다. max_images와 start_index가 있습니다. |
| **LC Image Compare 🔎** | 많은 이미지 배치를 컴팩트한 드롭다운과 고정된 이미지 영역으로 비교합니다. |
| **LC Image Crop 🖼️🔪** | 노드에서 박스와 핸들을 드래그해서 자릅니다. 비율 고정은 선택 사항입니다. |
| **LC Image Denoise** | blur strength, 가장자리 보존, 블렌드가 있는 스마트 노이즈 제거입니다. |
| **LC Image Desaturate** | factor와 휘도 방식으로 그레이스케일 쪽으로 채도를 낮춥니다. |
| **LC Image Grid 🖼️** | 이미지 배치를 그리드로 배열합니다. 간격, 윤곽선, 테두리는 선택 사항입니다. |
| **LC Image Label** | 워크플로우에 주석을 달기 위한, 드래그 앤 드롭으로 업로드하는 떠 있는 이미지 스티커입니다 (소켓 없음). |
| **LC Image Pass** | 이미지를 그대로 통과시키며, 활성화 스위치를 끄면 그 뒤에 매달린 노드들이 뮤트됩니다. |
| **LC Image Ref Pipe In 🖼️** | 레퍼런스 이미지를 최대 16장까지 하나의 pipe로 묶습니다. 소켓은 Text Encode Qwen Image 2.1처럼 늘어납니다. |
| **LC Image Ref Pipe Out 🖼️** | image ref pipe를 원래 슬롯의 image_1 ~ image_16으로 다시 풀며, pipe가 먼저 나옵니다. |
| **LC Image RGB** | 각 색상 채널을 따로 오프셋하고, 전체 strength를 줄 수 있습니다. |
| **LC Image Split 🖼️** | 노드에서 보는 전/후 와이프이며, 출력은 저장용으로 합쳐진 분할 이미지입니다. |
| **LC Image Stitch Multi 🖼️🪡** | autogrow 슬롯의 이미지를 나란히 또는 위아래로 이어 붙입니다. match size, align, 선택적 gap이 있습니다. |
| **LC Image to Total Megapixels 📐** | 이미지를 총 메가픽셀 수에 맞게 스케일하고 결과 해상도를 출력합니다. |
| **LC Image-Mask Resize 📐** | 이미지 및/또는 마스크를 프리셋, 사용자 지정 크기, 배수, 메가픽셀 수로 리사이즈합니다. divisible_by의 배수로 맞춥니다. |
| **LC Int Compare** | 두 정수 중 큰 쪽 또는 작은 쪽을 출력합니다. |
| **LC Int Split** | 전체 값을 분할 비율 지점에서 a + b로 나누므로, a + b는 항상 전체와 같습니다. |
| **LC Invert Boolean** | boolean, int, float를 변환해서 반대값을 출력합니다. |

| **LC Face Crop 📐** | Crops to a format with the faces placed well instead of a blind centre crop, using the Aspect Ratio Simplifier presets. Framing from widest to face only. |
| **LC Flux 3 Klein AnyPaint 🩹** | The same inpaint and outpaint for Flux 3 Klein, painted in edit mode with AusBoss's Outpaint LoRA: the area is filled gray and the model fills it while your picture stays put. |
| **LC Image Blend Advance 🎚️** | Places a layer on a background (position, scale, rotate, mirror) and blends it with 29 blend modes through an optional mask. |
| **LC Krea2 AnyPaint 🩹** | Krea 2 inpaint and outpaint with the AnyPaint LoRA. Everything outside the mask comes back exactly as it was, and the seam disappears. |
| **LC Mask Refine ✨** | Tightens a mask with a trimap, using a guided filter or VITMatte on the edge band only, with a before/after wipe. |
| **LC Normal Map (BAE) 🗺️** | Makes a BAE surface normal map (RGB = XYZ), the same style ControlNet's normal_bae makes. |
| **LC Outpaint 🖌️➕** | Drag the canvas edges outward on the node to build a grey canvas and a mask of the new area. max_megapixels stops the edges at that size. |
| **LC Outpaint, Rotate, & Pad 🔄** | Turn, crop and pad a picture by dragging on the node, with a portrait / landscape flip. The mask covers the padding and the corners a turn opens up. max_megapixels stops the frame at that size. |
| **LC Person Mask 🧍** | Selects parts of a person (face, hair, body, clothes, accessories, background) with Segformer or MediaPipe. remove_features makes a skin-only mask. |
| **LC Remove Background ✂️** | Removes the background with BiRefNet and outputs an RGBA cutout, the mask and the subject on a solid color. |
| **LC SDXL AnyPaint 🩹** | The same inpaint and outpaint for any SDXL checkpoint (SDXL, Pony, Illustrious), painted by ControlNet Union ProMax, Fooocus inpaint optional. No LoRA needed. |
| **LC Segment Anything 🎯** | Selects things by describing them, using GroundingDINO + SAM or SAM 3, with optional edge refine. |
| **LC Smart Detailer (pipe) 🩹** | The same, with model, VAE and sampler settings from the LC pipe. A wired model or VAE overrides the pipe's. |
| **LC Smart Detailer 🩹** | Replaces the SEGS / Impact detailers. Finds what you type (hands, face, eyes) with SAM 3 and redraws each one in its own upscaled crop, then blends it back in. |
| **LC VOSR2 Upscale (pipe) 🧩** | The same on the LC pipe, after the pipe detailers. Carries the detailers' areas to the new size (protected output) for LC Skin Upscale / LC Skin Texture. |
| **LC VOSR2 Upscale 🧩** | Fast, low-VRAM upscale with VOSR 2.0, built in: sharpens and adds fine detail without redrawing the picture. 1.5x to 4x in one pass, 6x and 8x in two. |
| **LC Z-Image AnyPaint 🩹** | The same inpaint and outpaint for Z-Image (Turbo / Base), painted by the Z-Image Fun ControlNet Union 2.1 patch instead of a LoRA. Everything outside the mask comes back exactly as it was. |

## LC Vision v1.6.0

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_Vision_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_Vision_nodes)

| Node | What it does |
|---|---|
| **LC Vision Caption 📝** | Generates text from a loaded LC Vision model, an instruction, up to three reference images and a reference video. |
| **LC Vision Danbooru Caption 🏷️** | Prompts for SDXL, Pony and Illustrious from one image or a rough idea: a short or detailed caption, real Danbooru tags, or a sentence plus tags. Optional quality tags and a matching negative. |
| **LC Vision Loader 🔬** | Loads a Qwen-VL GGUF model and its vision projector. keep_model_loaded off unloads it after the Vision nodes are done, so the image model gets the whole card. |
| **LC Vision Moviemaker 🎥** | Plans a video as several continuous segments in one call, each written as a self-contained MiniMax H3 prompt. |
| **LC Vision Prompt Enhancer 📝** | Rewrites a prompt through an LC Vision model using a preset instruction (text only). |
| **LC Vision Redirect (BETA) 🔬** | Kept for older workflows: LC Vision Showrunner now fixes the joins itself. |
| **LC Vision Reviewer 🕵️ (BETA)** | Quality gate: yes/no checks on hands, faces, text, artifacts, prompt match and your own questions. Flags a bad render, or blocks everything after it. |
| **LC Vision Shot List (BETA) 📋** | The story for the Showrunner, filled in like a form: the place, the cast and one row per shot. Suggests the segment count and warns about lines too long for their shot. No AI involved. |
| **LC Vision Showrunner (BETA) 🎬** | Plans a long MiniMax H3 video as CUT / CONTINUE segments, fixes each join to how the last segment really ended, and saves / loads the project file (shot list, references, settings). |

## LC ModelBuilder v0.6.3

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_ModelBuilder_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_ModelBuilder_nodes)

| Node | What it does |
|---|---|
| **LC Checkpoint Save** | Saves an all-in-one checkpoint (model, clip, vae) with an enabled toggle to skip the save. metadata: keep all, or necessary only (no workflow or training details). |
| **LC Diffusion Model Save** | Saves just the diffusion model, with no clip or vae. Same metadata switch. |
| **LC Face Variety Scorer 🧑‍🤝‍🧑** | Scores how alike the faces in a batch are (0 to 1, lower = more variety), plus a crowd score for group shots. Photo (ArcFace) or anime (CCIP) mode. |
| **LC Fingerprint Identify 🔎** | What is this model made of? Its recipe from your fingerprint library, block by block: which models were merged and at what ratio, merged-in LoRAs with their strength, how sure it is of each, and a heatmap. It can only name what is in the library. |
| **LC Fingerprint Library 📚** | Goes through your folders and stores a small fingerprint (about 1 MB) of every model and LoRA, with its family. Once a file is in, the original can go. Reruns only add what is new. |
| **LC Krea2 Block Merge Advanced** | Merges Krea2 checkpoints with a draggable per-block ratio curve across the 28 blocks plus sliders for the named regions. |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA Block ScanBETA** | Finds where a LoRA locks the face or changes the whole image by turning off one block group at a time, and suggests a block curve for the Editor. |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA EditorBETA** | Loads a Krea 2 LoRA with each of the 28 blocks turned up or down, attention and MLP scaled separately, and spikes softened. |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA MergeBETA** | Merges two to four Krea 2 LoRAs with a per-block A / B curve (sum or TIES). |
| **LC Krea2 Semantic Vector Tuner** | Amplifies or attenuates specific regions of a single Krea2 checkpoint's weights (not a merge). |
| **LC LoRA Extract** | Turns a finetune into a LoRA (finetuned minus its base): all layers, blocks only or a custom block list. Unchanged layers are left out. |
| **LC LoRA SaveBETA** | Saves an edited or merged LoRA as a standard file with every edit baked in, optionally at a new rank, with enabled and embed_workflow switches. |
| **LC Model Fingerprint 🔍** | One model against a reference, layer by layer, from the weights themselves: the same model at another precision, built on it, a block merge (the chart shows which blocks) or not related. With a LoRA: whether it was merged in and at about what strength. |
| **LC Model Merge (any precision)** | Merges two models stored in different precisions (bf16 with fp8, int8, nvfp4 or GGUF, in either order). The result stays full precision. |
| **LC Model Quantize 🗜️** | Saves a smaller copy of a model: fp8, mxfp8, nvfp4, int8 or int4 (load with the stock loader) or GGUF Q8_0 to Q2_K. From the wired MODEL (LoRAs baked in) or straight from a file of any size. |
| **LC Scoreboard 🏆** | Head-to-head counter for A / B tests: #1 Win, Tie and #2 Win buttons, with the leader and percentages shown on the node. |
| **LC Strip Metadata 🧹** | Cleans the metadata out of a model you already saved (embedded workflow, training details, titles). The weights are copied byte for byte, never loaded, so it loads exactly as before. Writes a _clean copy or replaces the original. |
| **LC VAE Compare** | Decodes the same latents with up to six VAEs, side by side with a 1:1 detail crop, a sharpness number and how far each lands from the first. |
| **LC VAE Merge** | Merges the decoders of two VAEs of the same family, coarse shapes to fine texture. The encoder stays the base's, so the result still fits the models made for it. |
| **LC VAE Save** | Saves a VAE to models/vae in fp32, bf16 or fp16. |
